Today's macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate includes a short video that appears to showcase the Visual Intelligence feature of Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods. The video can be viewed below.

macOS 26.7 Contains a Demo of Camera-Equipped AirPods

MacRumors discovered a short video in today's macOS Tahoe 26.7 RC, in which a man wearing AirPods appears to ask Siri to remember a book he is looking at, with Siri's voiceover saying:

The camera itself is not visible in the video, and the earphones look very similar to the current AirPods Pro. The most obvious difference is the stem, which appears to be slightly thicker.

Aaron Perris has also posted the same clip to X:

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple may launch camera-equipped AirPods, codenamed B790, sometime this year. Earlier today, MacRumors also discovered related references to B790 in macOS 26.7 RC, including code for an "image stream".

Interestingly, these AirPods are reportedly separate from another camera-equipped model that Bloomberg says Apple has been developing under the codename B798, which is expected to launch in 2027.

Given Apple's decision to include this demo in macOS 26.7 RC, these camera-equipped AirPods are very likely to be announced at next month's iPhone event.

What do you think of the video? Let us know in the comments section.
